title: Rifapentine
dek: A long-half-life rifamycin. Weekly in 3HP, daily 1200 mg in HPMZ, still an RNAP/rpoB drug, still a CYP inducer. Not interchangeable with rifampin milligram-for-milligram.
story: Rifapentine binds the same RpoB target as rifampin. rpoB RRDR (and I491F) resistance is class-level for practical purposes — a S450L strain is not a rifapentine opportunity. Pharmacokinetics are the reason it exists as a separate tablet: longer half-life enables weekly TPT (3HP: 900 mg RPT + 900 mg INH weekly × 12) and daily high-dose DS-TB (Study 31: 1200 mg).
Induction of CYP3A4/UGT still happens. Dolutegravir, DOACs, calcineurin inhibitors, and hormonal contraception care. Food increases RPT absorption — Study 31 was not a fasting ritual.
Do not substitute RPT 600 mg for RIF 600 mg and call it 2HRZE. Do not use weekly 3HP doses as daily HPMZ. Orange body fluids still happen. Hepatotoxicity still happens.
deep: Both now like 3HP as TPT and 2HPMZ/2HPM as a 4-month DS option for eligible adolescents/adults (CDC 2025; WHO Module 4).
Pregnancy: RPT TPT data thinner than 3HR/6H. Disease: HPMZ trial was not a pregnancy trial.
Rifabutin is the other rifamycin overlay for some ART co-administration in CDC-land; it is not rifapentine.
PubChem CID 6323497. Same RRDR as rifampin.

visual.caption: Same RpoB target, three pharmacokinetic objects. Bars are schematic dose intensity, not AUC tables. Do not swap columns.

example.title: 3HP weekly tablets given daily by mistake
example.setup: Pharmacy labels 3HP components daily for 12 weeks. Patient takes RPT 900 mg daily.

steps.title: This is not 3HP and not HPMZ
steps.body: HPMZ RPT is 1200 mg with MXF/INH/PZA. 3HP is weekly. You have an unstudied toxicology experiment.

steps.title: Stop, check LFTs, restart the intended regimen
steps.body: Induction and hepatitis risk are real.

steps.title: If the intent was DS-TB disease, you were also undertreating (no companion drugs)

example.takeaway: Rifapentine’s identity is PK plus rpoB, not a synonym of rifampin.
